blocks.text: ClearSkiiin weathered a fierce comeback attempt from the Armed Forces of the Philippines, holding its nerve in a five-set battle, 25-12, 25-14, 24-26, 14-25, 15-19, to preserve its unbeaten record in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Tuesday at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.
